### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window Geometry:** The splash window is a floating, non-maximized dialog positioned in the top-left quadrant of the desktop. 
    *   **Bounds (Desktop Relative):** Approximately `[0, 0, 405, 365]`.
    *   **Dimensions:** ~405px wide x ~365px high.
*   **Internal Regions:**
    *   **Background/Illustration Layer:** Occupies the entire window area `[0, 0, 405, 365]`. Contains a 3D isometric illustration of data recovery nodes.
    *   **Branding & Status Block:** Left-aligned content area located in the lower-left quadrant of the window.
        *   **Logo Lockup:** `[22, 92, 78, 182]` (Icon + Text).
        *   **Status Text:** Located directly below the title.
    *   **Progress Indicator:** A thin bar spanning the entire bottom width of the window `[0, 358, 405, 365]`.
*   **Alignment:** The text block is strictly left-aligned with consistent left padding (~22px). The progress bar is edge-to-edge.

### 2) TEXT
*   **Location:** Below the logo icon, left side of the window.
*   **String 1 (Title):** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard`
*   **String 2 (Status):** `Reading the disk information, please wait..`

### 3) COLOR
*   **Window Background:** `#F4F8FB` (ESTIMATED - Very light blue-grey/white).
*   **Title Text:** `#333333` or `#2C3E50` (ESTIMATED - Dark Grey).
*   **Status Text:** `#666666` or `#7F8C8D` (ESTIMATED - Medium Grey).
*   **Progress Bar (Active):** `#1890FF` (ESTIMATED - Bright Blue, covers ~90% of width).
*   **Progress Bar (Remaining):** `#FFFFFF` (ESTIMATED - White).
*   **Logo Icon Background:** `#1890FF` (ESTIMATED - Bright Blue).
*   **Logo Icon Glyph:** `#FFFFFF` (ESTIMATED - White).

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Title ("EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard"):**
    *   **Font Family:** Sans-serif (likely Segoe UI, Roboto, or similar system font).
    *   **Size:** ~18px - 20px.
    *   **Weight:** Medium or Bold (600/700).
*   **Status ("Reading the disk information..."):**
    *   **Font Family:** Sans-serif.
    *   **Size:** ~12px - 13px.
    *   **Weight:** Regular (400).

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Window Corner Radius:** ~8px - 10px (Rounded rectangle).
*   **Logo Icon Size:** ~56px x 56px (Square with rounded corners ~10px).
*   **Padding (Left Margin):** ~22px from window edge to icon/text.
*   **Vertical Spacing:**
    *   Top margin to Logo: ~92px.
    *   Logo to Title: ~12px.
    *   Title to Status: ~8px.
    *   Bottom margin to Progress Bar: ~100px.
*   **Progress Bar Height:** ~6px - 8px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Control Type:** Splash Screen / Loading Overlay.
*   **State:** **Loading / Initializing**. 
    *   The presence of the status message "Reading the disk information..." and the partial progress bar indicates an active background process (scanning/detecting disks).
    *   No interactive buttons are present (modal loading state).

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** **Flat / Filled**.
*   **Description:** A rounded square blue tile containing a white "First Aid Kit" or "Medical Bag" symbol (rectangle with a handle and a cross).
*   **Grid:** Centered within its blue container.

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Loading / Initialization**.
*   **Motion Cues:** 
    *   The progress bar is partially filled (approx. 90%), suggesting advancement toward completion.
    *   The text explicitly asks the user to "please wait", confirming a transient state.
    *   The background illustration is static in this frame but implies a "system check" or "data connection" theme relevant to the loading action.
